title: Brand
description: Changes the brand of a landing. colors: the brand, second brand, accent and call-to-action colours in src/styles/_tokens.scss, the browser's theme colour, and the favicons and share images that use them. logo: the person's logo files, and every brand file made from them. assets: rebuilds the favicons, PWA icons and share images. og: the share images of both languages, optionally with a new tagline.

ctaColor.description: Fill of the main call-to-action pills

logo.description: Path to the logo for light backgrounds (SVG, or PNG of at least 512 px)

logoDark.description: Path to the logo for dark backgrounds (defaults to `logo`)

mark.description: Path to a square symbol for the favicons

tagline.description: og: the tagline of the English share image (the Spanish one keeps the Spanish slogan unless taglineEs)

taglineEs.description: og: the tagline of the Spanish share image
